   - ts-jest - TypeScript preprocessor for Jest

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/registry-real.json` - Package registry with 20 FreeLang packages

   **Parser Fixes:**
   - `src/parser.ts` (Line 167 & 732):
     ```typescript
     // Before:
     this.expect(TokenType.RARROW, "expected '->'")
     // After:
     this.expect(TokenType.COLON, "expected ':'")
     ```
     Reason: FreeLang uses TypeScript-style return type annotations (`:`) not Rust-style (`->`)

   **Parser Enhancement for Anonymous Struct Literals:**
   - `src/parser.ts` (nud() function, added ~25 lines after line 451):
     ```typescript
     // Anonymous struct literal: { field: value, ... }
     if (tok.type === TokenType.LBRACE) {
       if (this.pos + 1 < this.tokens.length &&
           this.tokens[this.pos + 1].type === TokenType.IDENT &&
           this.pos + 2 < this.tokens.length &&
           this.tokens[this.pos + 2].type === TokenType.COLON) {
         // Parse anonymous struct with structName = null
         return { kind: "struct_lit", structName: null, fields, ... }
       }
     }
     ```

   **AST Modification:**
   - `src/ast.ts` (Line 66):
     ```typescript
     // Before:
     | { kind: "struct_lit"; structName: string; ... }
     // After:
     | { kind: "struct_lit"; structName: string | null; ... }
     ```
     Allows both named and anonymous struct literals

   **Codegen Update:**
   - `src/ir-gen.ts` (around line 399):
     ```typescript
     sname: expr.structName || "__anon_struct__",
     ```
     Fallback for null structName in IR generation

     - AST definition: `{ kind: "for_stmt"; variable: string; iterable: Expr; ... }`

     - Errors in: parser.ts, ast.ts, ir-gen.ts, checker.ts
